result:
Looking at this packet, my job is to break the core safety property, not nitpick style. Let me reason through each gate.

**Premise gate (`dream_gate._evaluate_dream`):** Anchors are resolved against real indexes and `contentHash` must equal `anchor_content_hash(resolved_object)`. `premiseConfidence` is recomputed mechanically and overwrites any model-supplied value; `all_resolved` requires every evidence item fully resolved AND no `citedEvidence*` reason. Acceptance additionally requires `not reasons`. Fabricated anchor / hash mismatch / missing recipe / bad mode all kill. I could not construct a fabricated-premise dream that reaches `all_resolved` through the gate. Solid.

**Review gate:** Enforced redundantly in `dream_run._require_reviewed`, `dream_generate`, `dream_research`, and `dream_gate`. A supplied `--capability-map` still passes `validate_capability_map` (component/node ids must resolve). Holds.

**Lane separation / preflight / offline:** `dream_emit` refuses `proposal.md` and only renders dream content; `dream_run._preflight` requires `--live-model` + resolvable key before any stage; tests inject models. Holds.

**The one real soft spot:** `dream_emit` trusts the `premiseConfidence` field at face value and does **not** re-resolve anchors against the source model — it relies entirely on the gate having produced its input. Within orchestrated `dream_run` the gate is the only producer, so it's safe; but `premiseConfidence: all_resolved` is a plain, unsigned JSON field, so any non-gate producer wired into emit would launder fabrication. Also `claim` text is unverified, and the `proposal.md` refusal is case-sensitive/exact-name.

{
  "verdict": "ACCEPT_WITH_CHANGES",
  "summary": "Core dream-lane safety holds: the deterministic gate kills fabricated/unresolved anchors via id-resolution plus canonical contentHash binding, mechanically overwrites premiseConfidence, enforces the review gate at four layers, and requires live model/key preflight before any stage. No fabrication path reaches dream.md through the orchestrated dream_run lane. Main weakness is that dream_emit trusts an unsigned premiseConfidence field instead of re-validating or requiring a gate marker.",
  "blockers": [],
  "requiredChanges": [
    "dream_emit treats `premiseConfidence: all_resolved` as load-bearing trust but does not re-resolve anchors against the source model nor require any proof the artifact came from dream_gate. Add defense-in-depth: have dream_gate stamp a verifiable gate marker (e.g. provenance.gatedBy + the gate prompt/input hashes it already computes) and have dream_emit refuse any dream/v0 lacking that marker, so emit cannot render a hand-authored or research-stage artifact whose all_resolved is self-asserted."
  ],
  "advisoryFindings": [
    "citedEvidence.claim is free text that the gate never checks against the resolved anchor; a real, resolvable anchor can carry a false/misleading claim that is rendered verbatim into dream.md. Premise 'resolution' guarantees the anchor exists, not that the claim about it is true. Acceptable for an advisory lane but should be documented as such at the rendering boundary.",
    "dream_emit's proposal.md refusal is exact-name and case-sensitive (output.name == 'proposal.md'); 'proposal.MD', or writing dream.md then renaming, is not prevented. The substantive guarantee (emit only renders dream content) still holds, but the guard is weaker than it reads.",
    "A reviewed capability map supplied via --capability-map is not bound to the current Project Model v1 graphHash; only component/node id resolution is enforced. A map reviewed against one snapshot could be reused against a different snapshot if ids still resolve. Consider asserting capabilityMap.sourceModel.graphHash == model graphHash in the gate.",
    "premiseConfidence/conclusionConfidence carried out of generate/research are model-controlled until the gate overwrites them; this is fine because the gate is authoritative, but it reinforces why emit must not be reachable without the gate (see required change)."
  ],
  "acceptanceAssessment": {
    "premiseGateKillPath": "pass",
    "emitDeterminismAndNoTrustLeak": "pass",
    "reviewGate": "pass",
    "laneSeparation": "pass",
    "offlineTests": "pass"
  }
}
